description: Search ILOSTAT's catalog of labour-statistics indicators by plain-language terms and filters. Each hit is one indicator with its datasets — one per available frequency (annual, quarterly, monthly) — plus breakdowns, coverage years, number of reference areas, source database, and last update; pass a dataset ID to ilostat_describe_indicator for its units and breakdown codes, then to ilostat_query_indicator or ilostat_compare_geographies for values. Every search term must match a word or word prefix in the indicator's label, subject, database, breakdown names, code, or definition; British and American spellings (labour/labor) match alike. Facet counts reflect all applied filters.

aggregates_only.description: Keep only datasets carrying World, regional, or income-group rows, dropping indicators with none.

breakdown.description: Classification type the indicator is broken down by, e.g. AGE, ECO, GEO, SEX; case-insensitive. ilostat_list_reference topic classification_types lists them.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token: the previous page's next_cursor, passed unchanged.

database.description: Source database code, e.g. LFS or ILOEST (the ILO modelled estimates); case-insensitive. ilostat_list_reference topic databases lists them.

frequency.description: Keep only datasets of this frequency: A annual, Q quarterly, M monthly. Narrows each hit's datasets; an indicator with none left drops out.

query.description: Plain-language terms, e.g. "youth unemployment" or "informal employment rate". Case, accents, and punctuation are ignored, labor matches labour, and a trailing plural s is tolerated. Omit to browse by filters (results then order by indicator code).

subject.description: Subject code, e.g. LUU (unemployment and labour underutilization); case-insensitive. ilostat_list_reference topic subjects lists them.

name: ilostat_search_indicators

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

catalog_as_of.description: ISO timestamp the searched catalog was last confirmed current.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_filter_code`: database, subject, or breakdown is not an ILOSTAT code. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode. `catalog_unavailable`: No catalog snapshot has loaded and the load failed, or the first load has not finished within 30 s. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Counts over the fully filtered match set, not just this page.

items.description: One facet value and its indicator count.
One frequency and its indicator count.

count.description: Matching indicators with a dataset at this frequency.

items.description: One facet value and its indicator count.

hits.description: This page of hits. With a query: tier, then more reference areas first, then code. Without: by code.

classification.description: Breakdown classification (e.g. SEX_AGE); absent when the indicator has none.

datasets.description: The datasets that pass the filters, annual first.

items.description: One dataset of the indicator at one frequency.

data_end.description: Last year with data (can include projection years).

dataset_id.description: Dataset ID — the indicator code plus _A, _Q, or _M — to pass to ilostat_describe_indicator, ilostat_query_indicator, or ilostat_compare_geographies.

has_aggregates.description: Whether this dataset carries World, regional, or income-group rows.

last_update.description: Last upstream update, ISO 8601 without zone offset.

n_records.description: Observations an unfiltered best-source download returns.

has_aggregates.description: Whether any listed dataset carries World, regional, or income-group rows.

label.description: Indicator label as ILOSTAT publishes it.

match_scope.description: Where every term matched: label (tier 1), label plus subject, database, breakdowns, and code (tier 2), or the definition text too (tier 3). Absent when browsing without a query.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Why the query was browsed by filters alone, how to widen a search that matched nothing, that the cursor starts past the last match, and how to reach the remaining pages — whichever apply, joined.

truncated.description: True when more hits remain beyond this page.

title: Search ILOSTAT indicators
